method.structuredAllowanceMeaning: false forbids treating the production text stream as a faithful structured transcription; a later source-visual transcription remains possible under a separate reviewed workflow.

restartSafety.resumeRule: Re-review only missing or stale entries, merge by paperId, and never propagate this scoped report into a QA acceptance or promotion decision.
